verdict.root_cause: paymentservice is functionally healthy; what broke is its telemetry export path. All nine recorded changes are automated toggles of OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT between unset and the loopback address http://127.0.0.1:4317, with the final set at 22:07:07 — six minutes before the 22:13:15 alert — left unreverted [tr_3eec73fcdc8a]. A loopback OTLP address names a receiver that is not there, so spans never reach Tempo and the span-derived calls_total series never appears in Prometheus: zero paymentservice spans across six pre-incident hours [tr_9c11b97d7914], and an error-ratio query with no samples in either the incident or the baseline window [tr_2763aaff5c6f]. The log path, which does not depend on the exporter, shows charge requests arriving and completing sub-millisecond on both sides of 22:13:15 with no errors, no restart output and no throughput gap [tr_29d582524105], and the caller checkoutservice had a lower error ratio during the incident window than before it while serving traffic continuously [tr_7fa6ab3c7e72]. The wrong endpoint value is itself the mechanism, so the alert is best read as the absence of paymentservice telemetry rather than a payment failure.
verdict.reasoning: Traces and metrics are both empty for paymentservice [tr_9c11b97d7914][tr_2763aaff5c6f], and the metrics specialist correctly read that as a series that does not exist rather than a measured zero. The exporter-independent log path shows normal, continuous, sub-millisecond charge handling straddling the alert [tr_29d582524105], and the immediate caller's errors fell [tr_7fa6ab3c7e72] — so no service-level failure is visible. The only candidate mechanism on the change board is the OTLP endpoint toggle, whose 22:07:07 set was the sole instance still in effect at onset [tr_3eec73fcdc8a]. A loopback exporter address is wrong in itself and that wrongness is the failure, which is why this is bad_config, not bad_deploy (no deploy or image entries exist [tr_3eec73fcdc8a]) or dependency_latency (nothing waits; in-service latency is sub-millisecond [tr_29d582524105]). Confidence is medium because the telemetry gap extends back further than any single toggle interval.
open_questions: Which alert rule fired at 22:13:15, and whether it was an absence-of-data condition rather than an error-rate threshold — nothing on the board identifies the firing signal.
Whether paymentservice spans exist at or after 22:07:07; the trace query ended at 21:13:15Z and never covered that period [tr_9c11b97d7914].

Why telemetry was also missing from 18:47 to 22:07 when the variable was unset, and whether real user impact occurred on the two unprobed edges — the checkoutservice query had no downstream dimension [tr_7fa6ab3c7e72].

alternatives.root_cause: The collector or telemetry backend receiving paymentservice spans is itself down or unreachable, independent of the endpoint value.
alternatives.why_not: It would explain the chronic gap, but no collector or backend was probed, while a concrete misconfigured loopback endpoint is recorded six minutes before onset [tr_3eec73fcdc8a]; it also leaves the onset timing unexplained.

alternatives.root_cause: A real failure on the checkoutservice-to-paymentservice edge exists but is invisible because the only metric query lacked a downstream dimension.
alternatives.why_not: paymentservice logs show paired request/completion lines under a millisecond and no errors across the alert moment [tr_29d582524105], and checkoutservice's aggregate error ratio fell rather than rose [tr_7fa6ab3c7e72].

proposal.expected_effect: After reverting OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT away from the loopback value set at 22:07:07, paymentservice spans should begin appearing in Tempo and the span-derived calls_total{service_name="paymentservice"} series should become non-empty in Prometheus within a few minutes, making the error-ratio query return samples instead of nothing. Charge request/completion logging in Loki should continue uninterrupted apart from the container recreate.
proposal.if_wrong: If, 15 minutes after the revert, Tempo still returns zero paymentservice spans and calls_total is still empty, the exporter endpoint was not the only break (the prior state was also unset from 18:47-22:07 with no telemetry, per tr_3eec73fcdc8a and tr_9c11b97d7914) and the fault lies in instrumentation or collector ingest, not this variable. Also note this action cannot be confirmed to silence the 22:13:15 alert, since no evidence identifies the firing rule.
proposal.risk: The revert recreates the container. If paymentservice is in fact unhealthy in a way the logs did not show, the recreate drops in-flight charge requests and briefly resets connections. If the prior configuration is itself the broken state (telemetry was also absent while unset), the revert restores a non-emitting configuration and consumes an outage window for no gain. It also does not stop the platform-automation loop that has re-set this variable five times today, so the value may be re-applied within hours.
proposal.blast_radius: paymentservice only for the recreate window; checkoutservice, its direct caller, sees connection resets on in-flight charge gRPC calls, and frontend may surface those as checkout errors. Tempo/Prometheus see paymentservice telemetry resume.

triage_judgement.reasoning: A critical alert on paymentservice with checkout and frontend downstream is a revenue-path failure that cannot be dismissed without evidence. Nothing in the alert pattern points to a specific cause yet.
